facts.fact: The Department of Immigration and Civil Status says its Civil Status Division has custody of the National Population Database, which it endeavours to upkeep and preserve.

systems.owner: Civil Status Division, Department of Immigration and Civil Status

note: National Population Database is named only as a system to interface with; the document does not state what it is or that it is a register in service.
Document is a companies bill; it says nothing about a population register.

facts.fact: The National Tender Board listing says the new Land Valuation System is to interface with the existing National Population Database (NPD), which implies it is in service.
